records.title: Face to Face (雙面伊人)
records.meta: TVB suspense drama · Hong Kong · Cantonese · 20 episodes · prod. & dir. Wong Sum-wai
records.character: Lam Ching 林靜 (Gigi Fu Ka-ying), who also has an alter persona, Ning 寧
records.summary: After a yacht explosion, Yiu Lok-tin wakes up with amnesia and is drawn to Lam Ching, now the fiancée of his 'brother' Fong Tak-shun. Ching turns out to have a second personality, Ning. Lok-tin hypnotises her to find out why Ning appears, and learns of a childhood trauma. Tak-shun is later revealed as the killer of Ching's parents.
gain_motive: therapy / finding the cause of her alter personality

episodes.gist: Lok-tin hypnotises Ching to find why Ning appears. Under hypnosis she says Ning began after she was locked in a room for a week as a child. Her mother overhears and feels responsible. Ching suddenly switches to Ning and kisses Lok-tin.
Ching is pregnant by her husband Tak-shun.
Tak-shun is exposed as a killer and crashes the car with Ching. She miscarries in hospital, and all three fall from a building during the rescue.

records.pregnancy_note: Pregnant in ep 18 (by Tak-shun); miscarries after the car crash in the finale.
records.kids_together_note: No surviving child; the ending after the fall is not detailed in the synopsis.

records.title: August Bride (8월의 신부)
records.meta: TV series · South Korea · Korean · SBS · 16 episodes (7 Aug – 25 Sep 1996)
records.character: Song Ga-young (Kim Ji-ho), a photographer; past life Yoon Jin-kyung
records.summary: Photographer Ga-young loses her memory in an accident at Cheongpyeong Lake. She starts hypnotherapy with psychiatrist Dr. Moon to recover it, but the hypnosis brings back memories of a past life instead, in which she loved Jae-min. In the present she is drawn to Nam-gyu, his reincarnation, and both later recover their past-life memories through Dr. Moon's hypnosis.
records.method: Hypnotherapy (regression, which leads to past-life recall)
records.pregnancy_note: No pregnancy in the available synopses.
records.kids_together_note: Ga-young and Nam-gyu part, then both die in an accident at the end.
records.evidence: Namu Wiki + Korean Wikipedia (broadcaster/dates); plot from a fan synopsis

records.note: One blog calls it an MBC weekend drama; Namu and Korean Wikipedia (via search) give SBS Wed–Thu, 1996, which is used here.

records.title: Durian's Affair (아씨 두리안)
records.meta: TV series · South Korea · Korean · TV Chosun weekend miniseries · writer Phoebe (Im Sung-han) · streaming Coupang Play
records.character: Du-rian (Park Joo-mi) and her daughter-in-law Kim So-jeo (Lee Da-yeon), Joseon women who time-slip to the present
records.summary: After a lunar eclipse, Joseon noblewoman Du-rian and her daughter-in-law So-jeo find themselves in a chaebol family's house in modern Seoul. When fingerprint checks fail to identify them, Dan Chi-gam and Dan Chi-jeong have both women hypnotised to learn who they are; in trance they start talking about their past.
records.hypnotist: A hypnotherapist arranged by Dan Chi-gam and Dan Chi-jeong

episodes.gist: Chi-gam and Chi-jeong arrange hypnotherapy for Du-rian and So-jeo. In trance, So-jeo tearfully talks about the past (it turns out to be about a dog), and Du-rian falls asleep, so neither session works. Later, Du-rian suddenly retches while eating with Chi-jeong.

records.pregnancy_note: Du-rian: in the finale she is asked to bear Chi-gam's child but vanishes with him through the pond on an eclipse day; whether she was pregnant is not stated. So-jeo marries Dan Deung-myeong and has a son, Dan Bin.
records.kids_together_note: So-jeo and Deung-myeong end with a son, Dan Bin. For Du-rian and Chi-gam, no child is stated.
records.kids_note: Du-rian has an adult son in Joseon, Park Eon (So-jeo's husband).

records.title: Desire Catcher (无眠之境)

episodes.gist: Hypnotist Lu Fengping guides college student Liu Ningning back to the incident scene under hypnosis; she becomes uncontrollable and he ends the session.
Under hypnosis she recovers a repressed memory: Gao Yongxiang hit his head after knocking over a teacher, and Lao Yang locked her in a room to protect her. She later remembers and surrenders.

records.note: Liu Ningning is described as a college student; her exact age is not given.
